findings.title: Style owner differs from the spec's wording
findings.detail:
Spec: 'no style nits (Biome owns style)'. The repo has no biome.json and no Biome dependency, so REVIEW.md says 'the type check and the repo lints in the unit tier own style'. Accurate for the repo as it is; it differs from the issue text only because the issue assumes a tool that is not there.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Keep it as is unless Biome is meant to arrive; then update this line in that story.
